=== chunk 0 | Getting started | location - | 18 tokens ===
--- context ---
Getting started
--- text ---
This guide walks you through installing the Widget Controller and registering your first widget.

=== chunk 1 | Getting started > Install the controller | location - | 71 tokens ===
--- context ---
Getting started
Install the controller
--- text ---
Download the controller package for your platform and run the installer. The controller listens on
port 7070 by default and stores its state in `/var/lib/widgetd`.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://acme.example/install.sh | sh
widgetd --config /etc/widgetd/config.toml
```

=== chunk 2 | Getting started > Register a widget | location - | 51 tokens ===
--- context ---
Getting started
Register a widget
--- text ---
Each widget has a serial number printed on its housing. Register it with the controller using the CLI:

```bash
widgetctl register --serial WX-2048-ALPHA --name "Line 3 sorter"
```

=== chunk 3 | Getting started > Register a widget > Verify the registration | location - | 38 tokens ===
--- context ---
Getting started
Register a widget > Verify the registration
--- text ---
Run `widgetctl list`. A healthy widget reports the status **ONLINE** within thirty seconds.

Next, read the configuration reference.
